title: Verse novels and graphic novels
log: 2026-11-12T12:44:17Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The bank point covers voice across poetry, novels and film, not hybrid forms like verse novels or graphic novels, so no existing point teaches the same idea.

draft.title: Verse novels and graphic novels
card: A hybrid form mixes features of different text types. It lets a writer tell a story in a way a plain prose novel does not.
A verse novel tells a long story through poems. Each poem may be a short scene or moment, and line breaks, rhythm and white space shape how it reads.
A graphic novel tells a story through panels, images and words together. Readers follow the order of the panels and read the pictures as well as the text.
In both forms the way the text is set out is part of the meaning. A short line or a wordless panel can make a moment feel quiet or tense.
draft.remember: Verse novels use poems and graphic novels use panels, and in both the layout helps to make the meaning.

a.q: What makes a verse novel a hybrid form?
opts: It tells a story using the features of poetry
It tells a story using only pictures in panels
It gives facts about real events in short chapters
It is a poem with no characters or events
a.why: A verse novel mixes the story of a novel with the features of poetry, such as line breaks and rhythm. It is not told through panels, which belong to graphic novels.
a.clue: Think of a novel's story told in poems.

b.q: Priya's graphic novel shows a girl waiting at a bus stop. One panel is a wide, empty street with no words. What is the most likely effect of this panel?
opts: It makes the moment feel quiet and lonely
It tells the reader the story is a poem
It replaces the need for any other panels
It shows the narrator is lying to the reader
b.why: In a graphic novel the image carries meaning, so an empty street with no words can create a quiet, lonely mood. The wordless panel does not mean the narrator is lying. A story still needs a sequence of panels.
b.clue: Pictures and white space can make a mood without any words.

a.best: It tells a story using the features of poetry

b.best: It makes the moment feel quiet and lonely
